Dear [Recipient’s Name],  

I am writing to wholeheartedly recommend Alexandra Chen for any opportunity where her technical leadership and collaborative mindset can thrive. As a skip-level manager at NovaSphere, I’ve observed her contributions to our mobile architecture practices over the past year.  

Alexandra’s work with Kotlin and iOS development has been transformative. She spearheaded the migration of our flagship app to Kotlin Multiplatform, reducing code duplication by 60% and accelerating feature delivery. Her ownership of the iOS team’s CI/CD pipeline resulted in a 40% reduction in deployment time, with zero regressions in production. She also led a critical refactor of our REST API layer, improving response latency by 25% and simplifying integration for frontend teams.  

Beyond technical impact, Alexandra’s mentorship stands out. She regularly pairs with junior engineers, fostering a culture of shared ownership. Her ability to balance deep technical rigor with clear communication has elevated our team’s productivity.  

Alexandra is a reliable, proactive problem-solver who consistently delivers under pressure. Her work ethic and curiosity make her an invaluable asset to any organization.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Title]
